comment: Phase 2 of BreakageIncludesSmeltingFailure: adds the 'failed' crucible type a failed smelt is turned into (see BlockEntityBehaviorSmeltingFailure), inert until cracked open with a hammer+chisel (CollectibleBehaviorCrucibleCrack). Reuses the fired crucible's own shape/textures — there is no separate cracked-open model.
Gated internally on the item actually being a BlockCrucibleFailed, so attaching it to every crucible variant (not just -failed) is harmless.
